lessons: Check sandbox egress to third-party APIs FIRST in a cloud session (curl the host); it decides what can be verified vs. handed to the user.
typer collapses a single @app.command() into the root command; add an @app.callback() to keep `tool subcommand` working before a second command exists.
http.cookiejar scopes a Set-Cookie without Path to the request's parent path; a fake login at /auth/login must send Path=/ or later /graphql calls go out unauthenticated.
ruff B008 rejects typer.Option() defaults; use the Annotated[...] form.
raw.githubusercontent.com URLs 404 when the default branch is master, not main; fetch the repo page first.
